Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left-hand lane and began a left turn at the intersection when the front of the vehicle was
struck by Driver 2, who was proceeding straight through the same intersection. On arrival, I observed heavy front-end
damage to Driver 1's vehicle, including a crushed bumper, a displaced hood, and a deployed airbag, all consistent
with the direction and force of the impact described by both drivers. Passenger was seated in the front passenger
position and was able to describe the sequence of events. Driver 1 reported pain in the right shoulder and was
evaluated at the scene by emergency medical personnel, and the nature of the injury fits the forces typical of this type
of collision. Photographs taken at the scene confirm the position of the vehicles and the damage described, but no
independent witnesses were located. Records available to me show no prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 is
listed as a member of the household of the registered policyholder and was operating the vehicle with permission.
